title: Titanium PCB Edge Grip
function: High-density board edge grip for PCB plating
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium PCB Edge Grip where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for High-density board edge grip for PCB plating requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by high-density board edge grip for pcb plating and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for plating rack geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with Class 6g gauge
Pickling and passivation with Class 6g gauge
Continuity test <1 mOhm with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for highdensity board edge application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for highdensity board edge performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium PCB Edge Grip resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium PCB Edge Grip resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for highdensity board edge.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium PCB Edge Grip orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium PCB Edge Grip is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium PCB Edge Grip?
faq.a: Each Titanium PCB Edge Grip shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for highdensity board edge.
